parameters: same native FLARE settings as the predecessor validation-locked winner; change reference-panel labels only
reference_labels: existing dataset-qualified fine reference populations, not country or nationality
source_mapping: fixed one-hot reference metadata mapping; sum all population probabilities into eight sources, never argmax
test_policy: development only; never load test predictions or test scores, never re-use the predecessor test for this new model
execution: explicit launch only after predecessor completion and successful cache cleanup; no background watcher, no automatic genome expansion
maximum_cohort: same 43 calibration plus 127 validation people; preserve all reference/train people and roles
small_population_policy: retain all populations and disclose reference counts; no oversampling, merging, fine-label accuracy claim or inferred country truth
